caption: The drawing depicts a single, headless, and armless mannequin wearing a brown two-piece ensemble consisting of a tailored, double-breasted jacket and a long, flared skirt. The jacket features a wide, pointed collar, two rows of buttons on the front, fitted sleeves with turned-back cuffs, and two triangular flaps at the waist resembling pockets or decorative tabs. The skirt falls to the ankles, has a smooth upper portion, and flares out towards the bottom, with a visible seam near the lower edge and a ruffled hem accented by two horizontal lines. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, less detailed line sketch showing the back view of the outfit, highlighting the general shape, seams, and length of the garments. The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or cream color.
title: Coat Suit
